nodes.name: Schedule — Every 20ms (50Hz AAMI Requirement)
nodes._comment: AAMI certification requires 50Hz data stream (1 update every 20ms). This telemetry count powers the AAMI panel.

nodes.name: Increment Telemetry Counter (Redis INCR)
nodes._comment: This counter is what the AAMI panel displays: 'Telemetry Points Logged: [COUNTER]'

nodes.name: Push Audit Record to AAMI Endpoint
nodes._comment: Every 20ms AAMI receives a certified telemetry record — this is the data stream FAA can request for audit

_meta.description: 50Hz (every 20ms) AAMI certification data stream. Each execution increments the telemetry counter and posts a certified audit record to the AAMI endpoint. This data is the foundation of the AAMI certification panel display and the FAA-auditable race record.
